pr_title: Multiple tokens support for migrating from github
pr_body:
Migrating a big repo from github will spend many days because of github v3 API's rate limit.

This PR add a feature to allow input multiple tokens with a comma splitter when migrating from github to make the migrating faster.

This also fix a bug that Proxy is not affected by migration with tokens.

Fix #14165
pr_comments:
> As far as I can see, this PR only attempts to lay the backend foundations for that feature. The frontend implementation is then intended to be its own PR, right?

I added a hint on github's token inputbox.
Should we warn users that abusing this feature may violate the service provider's policy and lead to account blocking?

issue_context.title: Multiple token support when migrating repository.
issue_context.body: For a big repository who want to migrate from Github, it will very slow because the rate limit per User. If the migration support multiple tokens from different user, then it will accelerate the process.

review_comments:
Is it OK to change `client` here? It was a `http.Client` with proxy and auth settings.

Even if the change is OK, a new variable name may make the logic more clear.
Is there an edging case? eg: if all client's remaining becomes 0, then this function seems to only refresh the first client's rate. Do other clients still have a chance to get a rate refresh?
Assume there is no rate limit, only the first token will be always picked. I think it's OK.
